To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
treatment decisions of asthma are based on a paradigm that includes clinical severity, and that treatment decisions are based on the asthma decision diamond.

asthma is a heterogeneous disease, and that the treatment decision is based on the stage of asthma, the asthma data base (including past history, current clinical findings, and physiologic data), and current knowledge of clinical research and clinical judgment.

the optimal treatment of asthma should be guided by an analytic decision-making process that is based on the clinical severity of asthma and that the clinical severity of the patient's asthma should be assessed by a clinical staging paradigm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an integrated decision model for the treatment of asthma.
the application of decision analysis to asthma management and treatment.
the development of a decision model for asthma that can serve as a guide in treatment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the treatment of asthma is best determined by a decision analysis that is based on a paradigm that integrates clinical staging with the latest research developments and the physician's clinical judgment.
the proper treatment of asthma is a function of the clinical severity of the disease, the natural course of the disease, and the proper use of available therapeutic modalities.
the treatment of asthma should be individualized and based on the severity of the asthma.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

asthma is a disease that can be treated effectively if the clinician has an understanding of the natural history, clinical manifestations, and pathophysiologic mechanisms of the disease, as well as an understanding of the pharmacology of the drugs used in its management.
the optimal treatment of asthma can be based on a paradigm for the severity of asthma.
the decision diamond is an important tool for the management of asthma.

the decision-making paradigm is the most important factor in the proper treatment of asthma.
the treatment decision diamond can be a useful guide in the clinical decision process of asthma.
